Defined in: [controllers/hotkey-registrations.ts:27](https://github.com/TanStack/hotkeys/blob/main/packages/lit-hotkeys/src/controllers/hotkey-registrations.ts#L27)

A Lit ReactiveController that reads every hotkey registration, chords and
sequences, from the singleton HotkeyManager and requests an update when
they change. Narrow each view with `kind`.

## Example

```ts
class ShortcutPalette extends LitElement {
  private registrations = new HotkeyRegistrationsController(this)
  private formatForDisplay = new FormatForDisplayController(this)

  render() {
    return html`<ul>
      ${this.registrations.hotkeys.map(
        (reg) => html`<li>${reg.options.meta?.name}: ${this.formatForDisplay.format(reg.hotkey)}</li>`,
      )}
    </ul>`
  }
}
```
